entities.name: Helinä Rautavaara
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Helinä Rautavaara was a Finnish explorer, adventurer, collector and journalist. She traveled in Africa, Asia and Latin America and collected ethnographic artefacts and information about cultures. Her collection is now displayed in The Helinä Rautavaara Museum in Espoo.
